# flo_curves provenance

flo_curves 0.8.1 (Apache-2.0) as Moda vendors it, with Moda's patch: collision sorts that cannot panic. Copied from
Moda's `native/vendor/flo_curves` unchanged; `MODA-PATCH.md` describes the patch. vork's workspace names it in
`[patch.crates-io]` so moda-scene builds against it, as Moda's does.
